  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ. (PMID 30392755)",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness. (PMID 30392755)",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor, and in the same operative setting whenever possible. (PMID 30392755)",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis. (PMID 39709737)",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions and on the genitalia. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation for primary excision has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21). (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation is a consensus‑based recommendation for general clinical practice. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation is for primary excision of suspected melanoma lesions. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation specifies a narrow margin of 1‑3 mm for excision. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation emphasizes performing histological diagnosis after excision. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation allows incisional biopsies on large lesions to facilitate diagnosis. (PMID 39709737)",
  "The recommendation is applicable to melanoma suspected lesions. (PMID 39709737)"
]
